name: Medzev (Slovakia)
description: Seven equal horizontal stripes of yellow, blue, yellow, white, yellow, blue and yellow, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature M-3/2005.
